notes.gamma: 1.0: the paper objective is the undiscounted success rate and undiscounted sum of D_coll.
notes.reward: r_t = lambda_Q * 1[success terminal] - lambda_D * D_coll / d_max_ms; d_max_ms is read from configs/default.json (400 ms).
notes.removed: No D_ref, no navigation-progress reward, no terminal bonus, no failure penalty.
notes.weights: lambda_quality / lambda_latency are trade-off knobs; 1.0/1.0 is a starting point, not a tuned optimum.
